decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt sits in the firm's core organic dairy offer and showed results above aspiration, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger search, though its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 adds some uncertainty.
The semi-hard cheese wheel uses the existing organic milk supply and processes at low marginal cost, so management keeps it despite less visibility on the website.
The spicy cheese line with several models can be trimmed variant by variant rather than dropped, and slack in a growing industry lets the firm carry it while results stay uncertain.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the cheese range, but dropping flagship Product B shows management prunes cheeses that fall short, so the risk is moderate and it is kept for now.

The niche washed-rind soft cheese, missing from the website for two years after the firm already withdrew Product B, likely falls short of aspiration, so its resources are better moved to the core dairy business.
